assumptions: make-invariant-review-bundle.sh is source-tree-only evidence: shipped to be read, not runnable from the archive
attrs.evidence: FALSE for the R2.1 bundle. Four records (LED-C9, LED-C10, LED-CB4, LED-NARROW) named AmpersandBoxDesign/box-and-box/test/laws.mjs, which the bundle shipped and which could not start from it: it imports twelve sibling modules the archive did not carry. `existsSync` was true and the evidence was dead. R2.1 had already gated the bundle by extract-and-run over the four commands its README advertises — this file was named as evidence without being one of them, which is the gap. Two fixes: the bundle now ships the import closure, and check-claim-ledger.mjs walks each witness's relative-import graph and refuses a witness that cannot load. MERELY CHECKING THAT A NAMED FILE EXISTS IS WEAKER THAN CHECKING THAT THE NAMED EVIDENCE RUNS. BOUNDARY, RECORDED RATHER THAN PAPERED OVER: of this record's two witnesses, check-claim-ledger.mjs runs from the extracted archive and make-invariant-review-bundle.sh does NOT — it builds the archive and cannot execute from inside its own output. It is shipped so a reviewer can read the generator, and it is SOURCE-TREE-ONLY evidence. The first run after this record was written was refused by the extract-and-run gate because the generator was not staged at all, which is the check doing its job on its own claim.
attrs.prior_art: Fable 5 reported it; GPT-5.6 specified the two acceptable fixes.
attrs.statement: In revision INV-R2.1, every executable witness named by a ledger claim could be loaded from the review bundle.
